text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock E after gains may have been driven by wanting to lock in wins; I should judge each trade by its future prospects, not my average cost or the urge to avoid admitting a loss.","The account rose and fell over these periods, but random past price changes do not predict what comes next; I should not treat recent moves as signals.","I should review the whole portfolio and my risk tolerance before acting, rather than letting loss aversion or checking prices daily push me into holding or trading without a clear reason."]}
